knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unclassified contaminated material is not ordinary waste. Double-bagging does not change its classification.
Custody and handling needs differ, so the two are kept apart.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes a mock waste log that records each change of custody. Pass: every change has date, time and a named person.
The learner lists the classification questions to answer before waste moves. Pass: at least three questions are listed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A contractor proposes ordinary rubbish or a private vehicle.
Waste is mixed with evidential objects.
